title: Structure and photophysical properties of new trinuclear lanthanide complexes (Ln = Eu and Tb) with 1,10-phenanthroline

synthesis.procedure: The europium sulphate salt (~0.078 g, 0.1 mol as printed; with phen ~0.1 mmol) was dissolved in methanol (10 ml) with 1,10-phenanthroline (~0.018 g, 0.1 mmol). The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 3 h. Colorless powders formed upon slow evaporation of solvent at room temperature. Colorless crystals of 1 were obtained after recrystallization from DMF (yield 65%).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution stirring at room temperature followed by recrystallization from DMF
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colorless powders obtained upon slow evaporation of methanol at room temperature; colorless crystals obtained after recrystallization from DMF.

properties.summary: Luminescent Eu3+ trinuclear complex. Room-temperature excitation (λem = 615 nm) shows phenanthroline-centered absorption plus sharp Eu3+ f–f lines at 395, 414 and 465 nm (7F0 → 5L6, 5D3, 5D2). 10 K emission (λex = 355 nm) is a 5D0 fingerprint of 1; spectral widths are too large for detailed crystal-field assignment.

measurements.name: excitation bands (Eu3+ f–f)
measurements.conditions: room temperature; crystals of 1; λem = 615 nm (5D0 → 7F2)

The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 3 h. Colorless powders formed upon slow evaporation of solvent at room temperature. Colorless crystals of 2 were obtained after recrystallization from DMF (yield 60%). Complex 2 is isostructural with 1.
